items_core.title: ZT135292/Dog_blood_transcriptomic_aging_clock: This repository contains code to construct canine blood transcriptomic aging clocks using gene expression profiles and age labels. Six machine learning approaches are implemented—Elastic Net, LASSO, Random Forest, XGBoost, support vector regression, and a mixture-of-experts model—and their predictive performance on age is compared and evaluated.
